DICKBUTT LAUNCHING ON SOLANA

PLANNED SOLANA MECHANISM

Creator fees.
Options trades.

DICKBUTT is planned for Solana. A configured share of creator fees would be collected and converted to USDC when needed, moved to Ethereum with Circle CCTP, and used to trade options through Derive.

HOW IT WORKS

Four steps.

01

Launch on Solana

The coin would launch as an SPL token and trade in a Solana liquidity pool paired with USDC.

02

Collect and convert the fee

A configured share from eligible pool trades would be collected and converted to USDC when needed.

03

Move native USDC

Circle CCTP burns USDC on Solana and mints native USDC on Ethereum. No wrapped copy.

04

Trade through Derive

The treasury deposits USDC into Derive and uses it as collateral for options trades.

UNDER THE HOOD

Solana for the coin.
Derive for the options.

The token stays on Solana. Only treasury USDC moves across chains. Derive matches the trades and proves and settles the exchange on Ethereum.

Why Derive?

Derive provides the options account, collateral system, order matching, risk rules, and Ethereum settlement. The trading key can be limited to trading only, with no withdrawal scope. DICKBUTT is independent from and not affiliated with Derive.

IMPORTANT

This is a mechanism, not a promise.

The final contracts, fee settings, wallet controls, and trading rules still need to be implemented and disclosed. Holding DICKBUTT does not guarantee income, returns, ownership of treasury assets, or distributions. The treasury can lose money.
